title: Advised
summary: ADVI'SED, participle passive 1. Informed; counseled; also cautious; prudent; acting with deliberation. Let him be advised in his answers. With the well advised is wisdom. Proverbs 13:10. 2. Done, form

inlines.v: ADVI'SED, participle passive 1. Informed; counseled; also cautious; prudent; acting with deliberation. Let him be advised in his answers. With the well advised is wisdom. Proverbs 13:10. 2. Done, formed, or taken with advice or deliberation; intended; as, an advised act or scheme.
